about: Language-neutral cases for how a Pipsocket SDK turns the API's answers into results, retries and errors. See README.md beside this file.

request_partial.message: Only part of the request was completed.

request_pending.message: No answer from the trade server yet. The order may still execute; it is not sent again.

request_unknown.message: The trade server's answer has not arrived in time. Until its outcome is known it blocks conflicting trades on its symbol; it settles when the terminal reports the answer, when the account's records show it, or when the account's owner settles it after checking the broker.

request_rejected.message: The stop loss or take profit is invalid for this symbol or too close to the price.

request_not_sent.message: The account's terminal did not send the request: 1000 trading commands are waiting for the trade server

result.message: The account's terminal did not send the request: 1000 trading commands are waiting for the trade server

request_not_executed_evidence.message: The request did not execute: the account's terminal never passed it to MT5.

result.message: The account's terminal never passed the request to MT5: its send ledger has no entry for it, and it can no longer arrive.

request_not_executed_operator.message: The account's owner settled this request as not executed after checking the broker. That is their finding, not MT5's answer: check positions and history before sending it again.

result.reason: No such order at the broker.

request_executed.message: The account's owner settled this request as executed after checking the broker. See the account's history for its deals.

result.reason: Found as deal 771203455 at the broker.

request_future_state.message: A state this SDK version does not know.

symbol_busy.message: Nothing was sent: an earlier request on this symbol is still waiting for the trade server's answer. Try again in a second.

kill_switch_not_connected.message: The kill switch is engaged, but the account's terminal did not answer, so nothing was closed. Engage it again once the terminal is connected.

kill_switch_outcome.message: The kill switch is engaged and the account has no positions or pending orders.

symbol_busy_unknown.message: Nothing was sent: an earlier request on this symbol has no known outcome yet. Look it up.

cases.title: 200 completed is returned
200 placed is returned
200 partial is returned and is final
200 executed (a key sent again, settled by an operator) is returned
202 pending is returned; nothing is sent again
202 unknown is returned
422 trade_rejected is returned as a rejected request, not raised, not retried
503 not_sent is returned as a not_sent request, not retried (the same key replays it)
409 not_executed settled by evidence is returned
409 not_executed settled by an operator is returned
a recorded request in a state this SDK does not know is returned as it is
409 symbol_busy with Retry-After waits that long, then the same key is sent again
409 symbol_busy with Retry-After on every attempt raises SymbolBusy: nothing was sent
409 symbol_busy without Retry-After is not retried
the blocker turns unknown between attempts: the retry stops
503 engine_busy is retried with the same key
503 engine_busy on every attempt raises EngineBusy: nothing was sent
a connection that never opened is retried
a connection that never opened, every time, raises APIConnectionError: nothing was sent
503 engine_unavailable: the same key returns or sends
504 engine_timeout: the same key returns the recorded request as it stands
503 engine_unavailable on every attempt raises OutcomeUnknown with the key
the request was written and the answer lost: retried with the same key
the answer is lost every time: OutcomeUnknown
a lost answer, then 401 (the key was rolled): still OutcomeUnknown, never AuthenticationError alone
a lost answer, then 404 no_such_account: OutcomeUnknown
504 engine_timeout, then engine_busy until retries run out: OutcomeUnknown, not EngineBusy
a lost answer, then 423 kill_switch_engaged: OutcomeUnknown with KillSwitchEngaged as its cause
a lost answer, then 423 billing_hold: OutcomeUnknown with BillingHold as its cause
504 engine_timeout, then symbol_busy until retries run out: OutcomeUnknown
a lost answer, then connections that never open: OutcomeUnknown
a lost answer, then 422 invalid_request: OutcomeUnknown
a lost answer, then the recorded request comes back rejected: returned
a 502 page that is not the API's JSON counts as maybe sent
a 200 that is never JSON ends as OutcomeUnknown, never a bare parse error
a 200 whose body cannot be read to the end is retried with the same key
a 200 that is JSON but not a recorded request is retried with the same key
a refusal status without a string error code counts as maybe sent
403 error code: 1010 is Cloudflare refusing the client: nothing was sent
a lost answer, then Cloudflare's 403: OutcomeUnknown
400 with no body (a ticket that is not a whole number) is InvalidRequest
401 missing_api_key raises AuthenticationError at once: nothing was sent
401 invalid_api_key raises AuthenticationError at once: nothing was sent
404 no_such_account raises NotFound at once: nothing was sent
422 invalid_request raises InvalidRequest at once: nothing was sent
422 magic_reserved raises InvalidRequest at once: nothing was sent
423 kill_switch_engaged raises KillSwitchEngaged at once: nothing was sent
423 billing_hold raises BillingHold at once: nothing was sent
503 account_not_connected raises AccountUnavailable at once: nothing was sent
503 bridge_outdated raises AccountUnavailable at once: nothing was sent
503 account_restarting raises AccountUnavailable at once: nothing was sent
404 no_such_order on a cancel raises NotFound
504 terminal_timeout on a cancel recorded nothing: retried with the same key
504 terminal_timeout every time raises TerminalTimeout, not OutcomeUnknown
an unknown code on a 5xx counts as maybe sent
an unknown code on a 4xx raises a plain APIError at once
no new attempt starts after the retry deadline
a Retry-After that would end after the deadline is not waited for
max_retries 0 gives the first answer's outcome
without Retry-After the waits are 0.5 s then 1 s nominal, each times a random factor from 0.5 to 1
a key the caller passes is sent on every attempt and handed back
the caller's key is on OutcomeUnknown
a key that starts with hk: is refused before anything is sent
a key that is empty is refused before anything is sent
a key that is longer than 128 characters is refused before anything is sent
a key that has a control character is refused before anything is sent
a read returns the body
a read retries 503 engine_unavailable
a read that never gets through raises Unavailable, not OutcomeUnknown
a read retries 504 terminal_timeout
503 terminal_error is retried once only
a read retries a lost answer
a read whose answer is always lost raises APIConnectionError
503 account_not_connected stops a read
503 no_price is not retried (the terminal already waited)
404 no_such_symbol raises NotFound
422 range_too_large raises RangeTooLarge
503 bad_command stops a history read
503 symbol_too_large stops
a read whose answer is never JSON raises APIError
looking a request up returns it whatever its state
check sends nothing to the broker and retries like a read
engaging the kill switch takes no key and is retried
503 account_not_connected on engage raises AccountUnavailable carrying the kill_switch view: it is engaged
engage that never gets through raises Unavailable
